# Contract: glyph

Imported from [Glyph-Skill](https://github.com/sumitttt4/Glyph-Skill) at `00d2bad` (MIT, Glyph Contributors); the bundle is kept as published. Category: design. Kind: guidance-only (no scripts by design).

## Purpose
Frontend design judgement for product-specific interfaces: understand, choose a direction, compose with real content, express personality, build every state, decide on motion, and verify real renders. Ships 19 focused references and a plain-CSS starter kit with 12 style-direction presets.

## Use it for
- "design a landing page for my product"
- "/glyph audit this dashboard"
- "give this app a real visual direction"

## Not for
- measuring a build against a fixed spec (design-to-code-inspection)
- applying another company's brand (brand-kit)

## Accepted inputs
A product brief, existing UI or code, brand constraints, the project's stack.

## Deliverables
Direction and composition decisions with reasons, implementation (or an implementation prompt), states, and a verification report.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- none

Optional:
- Node.js 18.19+
- Playwright npm package (npm install)
- Playwright Chromium binary (npx playwright install chromium, ~150-200 MB)

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local guidance. It links to two public reference libraries as optional reading; nothing is fetched automatically.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None.

## Workflow
1. Understand
2. Choose
3. Compose
4. Express
5. Build
6. Interact
7. Verify and revise

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Which direction and composition (the user may choose)
- Whether to animate at all
- Asset provenance and rights

## Quality checks
- Glyph's own verification and visual-craft checklists
- In SumitCraft: every starter-kit preset's text and accent contrast measured in a browser

## Common failures
- Copying a reference design
- Treating a successful build as a successful interface

## Limitations
- Guidance, not enforcement; 'commands' are prompt conventions, not CLI commands
- Taste hypotheses are labelled as such, not research findings

## Reproducible example
assets/starter.css rendered with each of its 12 direction presets plus the default, contrast measured (evidence/glyph).

## Validation status
**smoke tested** (2026-11-13, Linux 6.18.44-fc-v445 (x86_64), Python 3.13.18). 13 presets rendered; text, muted text and button contrast measured: below 4.5:1 or overflowing: bold button 3.28:1; retro button 4.30:1

Visual or audible review: none recorded. Native Windows: not run. Details and gaps: [docs/VALIDATION_MATRIX.md](../../docs/VALIDATION_MATRIX.md).
